verdict.rationale: Datadog has an AI assistant (Bits AI), so letting it consume tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Datadog's own MCP server, which serves Datadog data to other agents. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Bits AI or any other part of Datadog connecting to user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
